title: RMS normalization is not mean centering
purpose: Use a uniform vector to expose the operation that LayerNorm performs and RMSNorm omits.
contract: Uniform x=[4,4,4,4], positive epsilon; both gains 1, LayerNorm bias 0.
Mixed-sign fixture output RMS is about 1.342 after learned gain, not unity.
